verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a local or self-hosted Honeycomb instance; it is documented only as a hosted service that receives OTLP data. A developer can approximate a dev setup with the free-forever plan (up to 20M events and 100M metric data points per month), and environments can be managed through the API, which suggests isolated dev environments without stating it. missing for 10: a local/self-hosted or containerized deployment, explicit docs on dev/test environments for trying instrumentation and boards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
